name: Send test email between two test users
description: test-user-01 sends a single short test email to test-user-02. The mail body is minimal and deterministic for operator review. This scenario exists to validate that a delegated mail-send action is correctly attributed to test-user-01 in the tenant sign-in log.
correlation_strategy: Subject line includes a deterministic scenario-correlation token defined by the runtime runner. The token is logged in the scenario evidence record, not in the mail itself.
notes: Mail.Send is required. The Scenario Agent App does NOT currently have Mail.Send; it has only User.Read. The scenario is disabled until the permission is granted by a separate approved task.
